policy.publishedFiles: The installable package must not include packages/react/src files.
policy.publicExports: Root ./react exports and @design-system/react package exports must target dist runtime and declaration files.
policy.privateImports: Root private react import aliases may target source for repository tooling, but published dist runtime must not import those aliases.
policy.distRuntime: Published dist runtime/declarations must not import packages/react/src or private aliases that resolve to the src mirror.
